releaseNotes:
Bike Sync 2.4.25

- Gives Bike Coach the connected athlete's exact current-season (`s0`) power curve in both ordinary and athlete-scoped coaching reports.
- Keeps the existing 42-day, one-year, and all-time curves for recency, durability, and historical context instead of replacing them.
- Makes the report's data-coverage record explicitly verify all four requested periods: current season, 42 days, one year, and all time.
- Adds a regression test that fails if the current-season curve disappears from a future coaching export.
- Continues to use the current-season curve for the visible power radar, so the menu and Bike Coach now share the same season source.
